description: The Plakidas bridge, also called Kalogeriko, carries a wavy stone deck on three arches, the middle one the largest, over a shallow stream in a plane-tree ravine between Kipoi and Koukouli. The sky is clear, about 8.2°C at the Open-Meteo cell. The sun is still below the horizon. The ravine is unlit.
